name: looseleaf-ink
description: Unofficial standalone bundle of Looseleaf's ink core: hand-drawn pens, fills and shapes as SVG, no React.

scripts.build: esbuild src/entry.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=Ink --minify --target=es2020 "--banner:js=$(cat src/banner.txt)" --outfile=dist/ink.js && esbuild src/entry.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2020 "--banner:js=$(cat src/banner.txt)" --outfile=dist/ink.esm.js && cp src/ink.css dist/ink.css
